{{Top|leg}}
'''Memory enhancement''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to vividly replay a recent event and carefully examine the images and peripheral occurrences to recall details that might have passed them by.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[trance]] spell.
